title: China's Xi hails 'new start' in North Korea ties ahead of summit
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping is visiting North Korea to strengthen ties. This visit occurs as North Korea increases trade and military cooperation with Russia. China aims to foster strategic cooperation and socialism. North Korea has showcased its military strength ahead of the summit. This marks Xi's first international trip this year, signaling a new phase in bilateral relations.

title: 'Domestic cos got lower ubsidies than Chinese peers, on par with North America'
description: Indian firms receive far less government support than Chinese companies. An OECD report highlights this disparity between 2005 and 2024. Indian companies borrow at market rates, unlike China's below-benchmark loans. Key sectors like solar PV and semiconductors show concentrated subsidies in China. This data offers a clear comparison of global industrial support.

title: FTA talks with EAEU likely to take up agri, marine goods
description: India will discuss easing export compliance for marine goods, agricultural items, and processed foods with the Eurasian Economic Union. Talks will focus on sanitary and phytosanitary rules and technical barriers to trade. These measures act as non-tariff barriers. Indian trade negotiators will visit Moscow for the second round of talks. The terms of reference were signed last year.

title: RBI may need to absorb at least half of hedging cost to spur ECBs by PSUs
description: The Reserve Bank of India's new measures aim to boost foreign inflows. Public Sector Undertakings can now access concessional forex swaps for overseas borrowing until September 2026. Bankers suggest the RBI needs to cover at least half the hedging costs for this to make borrowing abroad cheaper and viable for these companies.

title: Paying tax won't legitimise cash stashes
description: The taxman is tightening its grip on undeclared cash, with a recent tribunal ruling allowing the benami wing of the Income Tax department to confiscate it. Even if tax is paid, individuals can't escape benami law if they fail to reveal the source of the money, impacting those trying to regularize unaccounted wealth.

title: Very short window for India amid China supply-chain shift, says CEA V Anantha Nageswaran
description: China's policies are hindering global supply-chain diversification. India faces a brief opportunity to attract relocating businesses. A proactive policy is crucial to capitalize on shifting geopolitical and economic landscapes. The nation's economy shows resilience but faces risks from inflation and trade deficits. Strategic reforms are vital for long-term economic strength.

description: President Donald Trump asked Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to refrain from retaliating against Iran's missile attacks. title: Iran launches missiles at Israel for first time since Mideast truce

This marked a significant escalation on the 100th day of conflict in the Middle East.
